title: feat: metadata_assistant agent, tool call display, and agent selector UI
body:
The AI Agent architecture (Agent → Skill → Tool) and metadata tools exist but aren't wired to a usable agent, the chat panel doesn't render tool calls, and `requiresConfirmation` has no frontend implementation.

### New `metadata_assistant` agent

- Binds all 6 metadata tools: `create_object`, `add_field`, `modify_field`, `delete_field`, `list_metadata_objects`, `describe_metadata_object`
- System prompt tuned for schema design: enforces snake_case, verifies existing schemas before mutation, warns on destructive ops
- `react` planning with 10 iterations and replan enabled for multi-step schema conversations

### Agent and metadata tools auto-registration in AIServicePlugin

- `AIServicePlugin.start()` now registers both the `metadata_assistant` agent and all 6 metadata tools via the metadata service
- Metadata tools only require `IMetadataService` (not `IDataEngine`), so they are registered independently of data tools
- Agent is stored as metadata via `metadataService.register('agent', ...)`, making it modifiable at runtime without redeployment

### Agent list endpoint and agent selector UI

- New `GET /api/v1/ai/agents` endpoint returns all active agents with `{ name, label, role }` summaries
- `AgentRuntime.listAgents()` reads from the metadata service and filters to active agents only
- AiChatPanel header includes an agent selector dropdown that dynamically switches the chat transport URL:
  - **General Chat** → `POST /api/v1/ai/chat`
  - **Data Assistant** → `POST /api/v1/ai/agents/data_chat/chat`
  - **Metadata Assistant** → `POST /api/v1/ai/agents/metadata_assistant/chat`
- Agent selection persisted to `localStorage` (`objectstack:ai-chat-agent`)
- Persisted agent selection is validated against the fetched agent list on load — automatically falls back to General Chat if the previously selected agent is no longer available or inactive
- Conversation is automatically cleared when switching agents to avoid context confusion
- Selector is disabled during streaming

### `requiresConfirmation` deferred

- `requiresConfirmation` is intentionally kept at `false` (default) on `create_object` and `delete_field` because the server-side tool-call loop (`AIService.chatWithTools`/`streamChatWithTools`) executes tool calls immediately via `ToolRegistry.executeAll` without checking this flag
- The flag should only be set once server-side approval gating is implemented to avoid a false sense of safety
- Read-only and additive tools remain unconfirmed as before

### AiChatPanel tool invocation rendering

Renders Vercel AI SDK v6 `dynamic-tool` message parts with state-driven UI:

| State | Visual |
|---|---|
| `input-streaming` / `input-available` | Spinner + tool name + arg summary |
| `approval-requested` | Yellow card with Approve/Deny buttons |
| `output-available` | Green success + truncated result |
| `output-error` | Red error + message |
| `output-denied` | Muted denied indicator |

- `formatToolArgs()` and `formatToolOutput()` are guarded against `JSON.stringify` edge cases (`undefined` return, `bigint` throws) with try/catch and `String()` fallback to prevent runtime crashes

Approval flow uses `addToolApprovalResponse` from `useChat`:

```tsx
addToolApprovalResponse({ id: approvalId, approved: true })
// or
addToolApprovalResponse({ id: approvalId, approved: false, reason: 'User denied the operation' })
```

### Tests

- 17 new service-ai tests: agent definition, tool references, guardrails, requiresConfirmation flags, `listAgents` filtering, agent list route
- 12 new studio tests: tool invocation part persistence round-trip, `chatApiUrl` routing, agent selection persistence
